itens.trecho: Novamente a Laika esta de parabens pelo ótimo trabalho que vem fazendo. Desta vez podemos dizer que o seu trabalho esta ainda mais complexo e refinado, sabendo fazer uso do stop-motion e da computação gráfica na medida certa, sempre ressaltando a 1ª técnica.

Every now and again there is an unexpected advantage in having a cinema membership. This was billed yesterday at our local Cineworld and so, to avoid the biblical torrents outside, I thought - why not? Well I am really glad I did.

A boy, a monkey and a giant beetle team up for a quest. This is not an old fashioned stop-motion animation. This is a very modern, a hybrid of multiple techniques that includes 3D printing and digital special effects. The directional debut for the producer of 'ParaNorman' and 'The Boxtrolls'.
